spec_match.rationale: Shows that content is the only opt-in, along with the UA defaults (24px, cursor help, user-select none), :interest-source styling and ::after ordering, all read back from getComputedStyle(el,'::interest-button').

interactive.rationale: Glyph, custom text, alt, size, gap, shape, colour pair, border, ::after and :interest-source controls, plus reset. The CSS is printed, and a computed-style readout with contrast and a measured box is shown.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The feature-index card describes exactly what the page delivers.

edge_cases.rationale: content: none, sub-44px warning, CSS-string escaping of quotes/backslashes (tested with a"b\), and transparent-background contrast fallback.

conformance.rationale: It backs the feature suite: box-generated / opt-in / valid-source assertions run live. 6 pass and 2 blocked with the flag. Without it, 3 pass, 3 fail and 2 blocked, which is honest.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 via Playwright (chrome-devtools-mcp is not available in this environment). Run with default flags and with --enable-experimental-web-platform-features, at 1280x800 and at 360x740 DPR3 touch. Every control was exercised, console, pageerror and failed requests were all zero, and overflow was 0px in every run. Flag: the box follows the rule (44→24px), and :interest-source turns the background black after a tap. Default: computed values resolve but width stays auto, which is labelled.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry.assert covers the primary contract and the labelled fallback branch, and load-time asserts wait for DOMContentLoaded because the telemetry script is deferred.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only. Button background overrides also set color, and contrast is checked (accent-blue on paper is 7.86:1).

accessibility.rationale: Every control has a label, the range values are mirrored in their labels, focus-visible outlines are present, and the verdict is aria-live polite.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Fixed a 30px overflow at 360px (unbreakable H2). Re-verified at 0px. The controls stack on mobile.

openQuestions.title: Add hover/active state readout
openQuestions.detail: The UA :hover/:active color-mix backgrounds cannot be read from getComputedStyle without forcing state. Consider DevTools-forced-state instructions or a screenshot comparison.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use popover=hint targets with interestfor and position them with the implicit anchor via position-area and position-try-fallbacks. Do not add role=tooltip or aria-describedby by hand.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The cards are popover=hint with position-area: block-end span-inline-end and flip fallbacks. No manual ARIA wiring was added.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel form without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use grid/flex with minmax(0,1fr), min-width:0 and overflow-wrap so long tokens cannot widen the layout.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The stages are min-width:0 grids, and headings and code use overflow-wrap:anywhere. This fixed a measured 30px overflow on the inspector at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce async status with a single polite region, and size targets at least 24px (bump them up on coarse pointers).
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Logs use role=log or polite regions. The pseudo and fallback buttons have min 44x44px and every other control is 44px tall.

summary: Built and self-reviewed in the same pass. Evidence is from headless Chrome 153 with and without the runtime flag. chrome-devtools-mcp was unavailable, so accessibility-tree claims are unverified.
